task.title: P6-145: Scope tr_recent_places to the user and clear it on sign-out
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-145. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`tr_recent_places` in `localStorage` is per-origin, not per-user, and is not cleared on sign-out** (was `P6-030e`; `palette.rs:110`), so foreign collection ids survive a user switch and are discarded only by `at_rest`'s index reconcile (`:406`). No names leak — the reconcile is the only thing standing between it and a cross-account row.
